She is arrested by the police, charged with Laura's murder, and remanded in custody in May 2004.

characters.review_note: Codex source inspection, 17 October 2026: captured character article, infobox aliases/performers and revision metadata checked. Prominence-based curated selection, not a ranked or exhaustive canon. Identity linkage is not independent story corroboration.

score.scope: Exposed selected incidents and in-catalogue assertions only. Exact values include participant-role assignment, event type, basis, account status, polarity, certainty, story time/precision and evidence IDs. Ignore arbitrary claim/event ID spelling and label wording; incident grouping requires separate support review. Full-value duplicates collapse. Each dimension projects unique full assertions onto values plus passage IDs and event type, preserving multiplicity: identity sets, role multisets, assigned identity-role pairs (direction), polarity, timing, or account attribution. These are diagnostics, not independent per-claim accuracies. Grounding separately requires exact resolvable locators covering frozen supporting spans; it is not canon adjudication. Text classifications are scored separately by kind, character subjects, theme and passage IDs; classification-gap wording is source-reviewed rather than exact-matched. A text classification never counts as an event or connection.

arrest.scope: Exact normalized values within each completely annotated selected input passage. Instances match on values and sorted unique passage IDs, independently of quote offsets. Claim IDs are ignored; semantic duplicates within a passage collapse and are counted. Grounding additionally requires the entire independently reviewed supporting span. These exposed development scores are not held-out or broad-corpus quality.
